description: This file contains automated test cases using pytest for verifying the rbus data handlers related to device IP configurations, device info, services, and reverse SSH settings in a TR-069 or similar device management context.

methods.name: test_DeviceDefault_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Test for getting and setting device default data elements like software version, model name, firmware filename, and RFC feature status.

methods.name: test_DeviceIP_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Test for verifying get operations on multiple IPv6 and IPv4 interface configurations, including IPv6 prefix, address, origin, lifetime, and IPv4 enablement.

methods.name: test_DeviceServices_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Test for verifying get operation on device services, specifically the number of STB service entries.

methods.name: test_ReverseSSH_Set_Get_Handler()
methods.description: Test for retrieving reverse SSH status, setting trigger command, and setting SSH arguments.
